from typing import Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDetails(BaseModel):
    """Extractable identifiers from a single judgment document for matching."""
    parties: list[str] | None = Field(description="Names of parties involved: appellant, appellee, petitioner, respondent")
    first_instance_case_number: str | None = Field(description="First instance court case number e.g. (2022) 粤 0111 民初 14279 号")
    court_location: str | None = Field(description="City or district of the court handling the case")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="Type of dispute e.g. Property division, Inheritance, Patent infringement")
    litigation_fees: list[str] | None = Field(description="Raw strings of litigation fee amounts and responsibility, e.g. 11034 元 by Deng")
    specific_amounts: list[str] | None = Field(description="Specific sums ordered in judgment e.g. Pay 616761.97 元 for mortgage advance")
    final_disposition: str | None = Field(description="Core outcome e.g. Upheld, Dismissed, Withdrawn")
    is_final_judgment: bool | None = Field(description="Whether document states this is the final judgment")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseDetails]
